statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. NQ extended below the first rebound range while oil, yields, VIX futures and Asian equities aligned with the geopolitical shock.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail remains elevated while the failed rebound and cross-asset confirmation persist; durable two-sided recovery would reduce the pathological-path case.
headline: Renewed overnight extension keeps Tail elevated
body: Delayed NQ is near 29,364.50 after a 29,273.50 low, below the prior assessment quote near 29,431.50. U.S.-Iran retaliation remains unresolved; oil and yields are higher, VIX futures are firmer and Asian equities are weaker. The rebound from the new low prevents a high-Tail one-way classification.

lookbackSummary: Tail stayed at 19% through 20:00 UTC on August 30, rose to 24% on the geopolitical escalation, reached 28% at the 22:00 reopen, eased to 24% on the first rebound, then returned to 26% at 00:00 as downside resumed.
outlookSummary: Tail is elevated because the overnight rebound failed and NQ extended lower alongside oil, yield, volatility and Asian-equity pressure. The primary danger window is 01:00-04:00 UTC; secondary checkpoints are Europe, the U.S. cash open and Dallas Fed at 14:30 UTC.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ near 29,364.50 remains below the prior 29,431.50 quote after a 29,273.50 low. The failed rebound and aligned oil, yields, VIX futures and Asian weakness keep Tail elevated; the rebound from the low argues against a high-Tail one-way regime.
drivers: Failed rebound plus renewed downside extension

forecast.analysis: Tail falls to WATCH if Asian trade stops extending. Fresh escalation or another failed rebound would keep the overnight danger window active.
European pre-open Tail remains WATCH unless overnight weakness broadens; stabilization in NQ, rates and oil would support further normalization.
Europe's open is a fresh checkpoint: synchronized weakness and renewed NQ extension would lift persistence risk; two-sided trade would keep Tail at WATCH.
After Europe opens, Tail remains WATCH if regional weakness does not produce repeated NQ extension; shallow rebounds and fresh lower lows would invalidate easing.
Mid-European Tail eases if price discovery remains two-sided; holding near overnight extremes with aligned oil and yields would prevent normalization.
Tail stays in WATCH as Europe matures, conditional on no fresh one-way NQ sequence. Geopolitical headlines remain the main restart risk.
Late Europe carries a narrower danger window. Mean reversion would keep Tail near the bottom of WATCH; renewed downside efficiency would lift it.
U.S. premarket liquidity is the next structure checkpoint. Re-acceleration with shallow pullbacks would lift Tail; orderly range trade would not.
The U.S. cash open is a conditional danger point. Opening-auction continuation and shallow pullbacks would lift Tail toward elevated; two-sided trade would keep WATCH.
The 14:00-15:00 UTC hour includes Dallas Fed at 14:30 UTC. Tail is elevated only if the cash-open path and data reaction align into persistent extension.
After Dallas Fed, Tail returns to WATCH if the release is absorbed with meaningful retracements; a sustained second leg after failed pullbacks would keep risk elevated.
Early U.S. afternoon Tail eases if price discovery remains balanced after morning catalysts; renewed directional efficiency would interrupt normalization.
Mid-afternoon Tail stays at WATCH while the market tests whether the overnight shock has mean-reverted; repeated extension without recovery would lift risk.
Late-afternoon Tail is lower if NQ rotates rather than holds a session extreme. High cross-asset Stress alone does not establish a pathological price path.
Power-hour Tail remains WATCH because late continuation can restore directional efficiency; a failed breakout or sustained reversal would support normalization.
After the U.S. cash close, Tail eases if no late one-way extension developed; geopolitical headline sensitivity remains elevated into the futures transition.
The futures maintenance transition carries low Tail absent a fresh catalyst. Stress stays high because geopolitical and rate risks remain unresolved.
At the next Globex reopen, Tail returns to WATCH as liquidity resets. A material gap with immediate follow-through would matter; a two-sided reopen would not.
Late U.S. evening Tail stays near the bottom of WATCH if the reopen lacks persistent extension; fresh military or policy headlines remain the main amplifier.
The September 1 Asian-session start carries WATCH risk ahead of later U.S. checkpoints: Barr, JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and construction spending.
drivers: September 1 macro stack later in day
